title: Grade 5 French — Mon, Jun 16
description: Le corps humain — Day 1 of 5: Les parties du corps (body parts vocabulary)
subject: french

questions.question: "Le corps" means:
questions.explanation: Le corps = the body. Le corps humain = the human body.

questions.question: "La tête" means:
questions.explanation: La tête = the head. La tête is feminine.

questions.question: "Le bras" means:
questions.explanation: Le bras = the arm. Le bras is masculine. Two arms = deux bras (no plural s change, the s is already there).

questions.question: "La jambe" means:
questions.explanation: La jambe = the leg (the whole leg). La jambe is feminine.

questions.question: "La main" means:
questions.explanation: La main = the hand. La main is feminine. Two hands = les deux mains.

questions.question: "Le pied" means:
questions.explanation: Le pied = the foot. Le pied is masculine.

questions.question: "Le visage" / "la figure" means:
questions.explanation: Le visage (or la figure) = the face. You can use both words.

questions.question: "L'épaule" means:
questions.explanation: L'épaule = the shoulder. Feminine noun, starts with a vowel → l'épaule.

questions.question: "Le genou" means:
questions.explanation: Le genou = the knee. Plural: les genoux (irregular — genou → genoux).

questions.question: "Le dos" means:
questions.explanation: Le dos = the back. 'J'ai mal au dos' = I have backache.

questions.question: "Le cou" means:
questions.explanation: Le cou = the neck. Short word, masculine.

questions.question: "Le ventre" means:
questions.explanation: Le ventre = the stomach / belly. J'ai mal au ventre = I have a stomach ache.

questions.question: Which of these is feminine?
questions.explanation: La main is feminine. Le bras, le pied, le dos are all masculine.

questions.question: How do you say 'I have two arms and two legs'?
options: J'ai deux bras et deux jambes.
J'ai un bras et un jambe.
J'ai deux bras et deux pied.
J'ai des bras et des jambe.
questions.explanation: Deux bras (bras doesn't change in plural — already ends in -s). Deux jambes (fem. plural). J'ai deux bras et deux jambes.

questions.question: Point to your knee and say it in French: 'This is my ___.'
questions.explanation: C'est mon genou = This is my knee. Genou is masculine → mon (not ma).
